- Security contact: Samir Patel (samir.patel@helixhealth.com) — he asked I include him on this thread and that you kick off the Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ).

  2) Confirmation that data at rest is encrypted (ALG + KMS provider) and key management details.
  3) Retention: what’s your default retention for logs that may contain identifiers?

We typically send the VSQ as an Excel; if you can open that and provision portal access for Samir and procurement, that would be perfect.
